summary: Kerb along an open park, with homes only across the road.

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto open park with large trees; homes across the road are roughly 20 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb on a residential street with room beside parked cars; no verge or bay.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, a junction just west at 300 m.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both sides nearby; signs are 2P Mon-Fri 7am-7pm only, resident permits excepted.

flags: Slope about 3.3%, steeper than the 3% line
2P limit 7am-7pm on weekdays, so park after 7pm and leave before 7am
Dwelling 11 m at 296 m and 13 m at 421 m bracket the section
sun_shade: Large park trees overhang the kerb from the south; open to the north sun.

best_section.where: Park-side kerb between the Marmion Pde crossroads and the first houses to the east
